prompt: I need to connect a list of FBIDs found in support tickets (the dim_tier1_job_final table) to a list of page IDs found in a target list. Unfortunately, our support tickets typically don't include a page ID. How can I connect these two lists of data in Daiquery?
response:
To connect the list of page IDs to the list of FBIDs, you can use a simple join operation in Daiquery. Assuming the page IDs are stored as a single column, you can use the following query:

```sql
SELECT dim_tier1_job_final.fb_id, dim_tier1_job_final.page_id
FROM dim_tier1_job_final
JOIN dim_tier1_job_final_page ON dim_tier1_job_final.fb_id = dim_tier1_job_final_page.fb_id;
```

This query will return all the FBIDs and page IDs associated with each ticket.
